basic_info.description: This is a tastefully designed home with a reimagined floor plan that takes advantage of the Sunset and Pacific Ocean views. The family lovingly remodeled the home over the past ten years with new electrical, lighting, mechanical, plumbing, windows, doors, skylights, roof, and deck with backyard access to a new hot tub and outdoor fire pit. Upstairs features an open concept with living room, dining room and upscale kitchen with waterfall marble countertop and high-end stainless steel appliances. The home has hardwood floors throughout and sliding glass doors that are great for indoor/outdoor living with a private redwood deck that overlook breathtaking neighborhood and ocean views, perfect for entertainment! Upstairs has two bedrooms with ample closet space and a shared remodeled bathroom with timeless subway tile, octagon marble flooring, walk-in shower, and new fixtures. Downstairs area consists of a master bedroom which includes an on-suite bathroom with a double vanity and a sliding door with access to a private hot tub, outdoor shower, and multi-tiered landscaped backyard. Garage comes with a new garage door, plenty of storage space, and washer and dryer. This home is anticipating a new owner who will sit back on its private deck and enjoy the golden hour and stunning sunset!
